nodes.title: Owner 2026-10-10 ~19:00 UTC: the avatar (grown-up Asha) is an add-on to build later; the main product is the tutor described earlier (gamified app, games and content built on the go, understanding detection, a human-like tutor with a bond, 'just start the session, she asks what happened at school today and handles everything'); focus there; asked where product design, UI/UX, user flow and journey stand

Merge order after the owner's directive: stream 2 fix + safety release 6, then G1, then Kaksha K0-K3 (ui.kaksha on for the owner's account), then 4A's batch (conversation quality, session-first owner cohort), then G2, 4B, 3, and 5b (avatar) last; avatar work on hold; stream 5 reassigned to an end-to-end journey audit

md.decisions: - `dc-r4-merge-order-core-first` (2026-10-10): after the owner's directive (owner-core-over-avatar-20261010) the merge order becomes: stream 2's packaging fix with safety release 6; G1 (games core, which K2 depends on); Kaksha K0-K3 with ui.kaksha on for the owner's account only; 4A's batch (patch 14, protegeNotChild, 13-shadow, the leak fix, K-P11, TAXILA_ACK_CLOSE off, a session-first owner cohort); G2; 4B; 3; 5b last. Grown-up Asha for the owner's account waits until they ask again; avatar work (r8 bilabial wiring, the lamp2 blend) is on hold; stream 5 runs an observation-only end-to-end journey audit (today's app and Kaksha + session-first) scored against the owner's vision. Reverse if: the owner asks for the avatar again, or the audit shows a different core gap should lead.
